Third-party files vendored under external/reshade/include/
============================================================

Unmodified, byte-for-byte copies of the ReShade addon SDK headers from
https://github.com/crosire/reshade (include/reshade*.hpp) and the matching
Dear ImGui stub headers they require (imgui.h, imconfig.h, ImGui 1.92.50,
https://github.com/ocornut/imgui).

ReShade is licensed under the BSD 3-Clause license; Dear ImGui under MIT.
See release/THIRD_PARTY.txt for the full texts. Each header retains its
original copyright notice and SPDX-License-Identifier.
